purpose: Verify whether an SDXL Plus IP-Adapter can replace the existing generic SDXL IP-Adapter under the Animagine XL and OpenPose ControlNet pipeline.
result: generated and reviewed; PNG pruned because it failed the publication-quality gate
assessment: The SDXL Plus and ViT-H combination generated successfully on the 8 GB GPU, but did not improve bag geometry or color consistency enough to replace the generic adapter.
